subject: Activation slate: exception action items & timing
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation slate: exception action items & timing

Team —

We have a compressed activation window for Primera (pilot) and there are three exception asks that product and ops must sign off on before we can commit to the proposed go-live on June 6. I pulled together a short matrix (attached) with proposed mitigations and owners. Quick ask list: 

1) Product: confirm scope trim for the external-facing analytics card (can we drop 2 non-critical metrics to reduce inference cost?) — owner: Marissa
2) Ops: confirm whether we can reserve burst capacity for week-of cutover (East region) and accept an SLA exception for token-level tail latency — owner: Vivek
3) Docs/Enablement: prepare a one-page runbook and customer-facing FAQ for approved exceptions — owner: Grace

Please reply inline with "accept / request changes" and estimated completion times. If we cannot converge by EOD tomorrow I'll escalate to the sales exec and procurement contact.

Attachments: activation_matrix.xlsx, exception_request_form.pdf

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation slate: exception action items & timing

Thanks — quick replies inline: 

1) Analytics card scope: accept (I can drop 2 metrics: session entropy + model drift score). That reduces peak token work for the dashboard render by ~18%. I will update the activation_matrix and tag the frontend PR. ETA: 2028-05-27 17:00 PDT.

Notes: dropping metrics is product-approved for pilot only; we should flag the roadmap follow-up for broad launch.

2) For the conditional reroute that shows short-lived KPI blips, we still need the full trace on the backend for debugging. I'll add a toggle to capture traces only when the card is in pilot (no perf impact for others).

Attaching a brief change note to the matrix.

-Marissa
Senior PM, Product
Redwood Inference

I can provision a short-lived burst pool in us-east for the week-of cutover and accept an SLA exception limited to token tail latency for pilot customers. Conditions: 

- Exception window: 2028-06-06 00:00 UTC through 2028-06-13 23:59 UTC
- Exception scope: Primera pilot only; enforced via routing policy and customer tag
- Mitigation: we will enable KV-prefix caching for the analytics card and cap batch size to reduce tail risk

I'll prepare the SLA-exception-summary.docx (attached) with the caveats and required approval flow. I need sign-off from Jordan for escalation to procurement to request the reserved capacity budget. ETA for internal docs: 2028-05-24 10:30 PDT.

-Vivek
Director, Operations
Redwood Inference
